svg.title: A McCulloch–Pitts artificial neuron: inputs x_1 to x_n with weights w_1 to w_n, plus a weight w_0 on a constant input 1, feed a summation unit that outputs w^t x; a threshold unit with threshold b then outputs the step function H(w^t x − b), equal to 1 when w^t x − b ≥ 0 and 0 otherwise.
